label: Screencap Grid
description: Displays formatted ffprobe info in a top pane with a rows x cols grid of the same media below. Renders a static PNG contact sheet or an animated MP4 grid via the Output knob. v2 lays the pane and tiles out as exact pixel rects via inset-recovery placement, so tile gaps are pixel-exact at every canvas.

sourceIds.label: Source(s)
sourceIds.description: Source video(s) for the grid — pick a folder, one or more files, or drag-and-drop. One render per file (emit:multi when >1).

outputFormat.label: Output
outputFormat.description: Deliverable format. "png" renders a static contact sheet; "mp4" renders an animated grid where each tile plays from its timestamp.

rows.label: Rows
rows.description: Number of rows in the screenshot grid.

cols.label: Cols
cols.description: Number of columns in the screenshot grid.

infoPane.show.label: Show
infoPane.show.description: Show the info pane above the grid.

infoPane.align.label: Align
infoPane.align.description: Alignment of the pane text (filename + metadata).

infoPane.label: Info Pane
infoPane.description: Info pane with filename + ffprobe metadata above the grid.

timestamps.show.label: Show
timestamps.show.description: Overlay a timestamp in each tile.

timestamps.corner.label: Corner
timestamps.corner.description: Which corner the chip sits in.

timestamps.bgColor.label: Background
timestamps.bgColor.description: Chip background behind the glyphs. Defaults to black; "none" is transparent.

tiles.gapPx.label: Gap (px)
tiles.gapPx.description: Gap between tiles, in pixels (exact at every canvas).

tiles.fit.label: Fit
tiles.fit.description: cover crops to fill; contain letterboxes the whole frame.

advanced.customGrid.label: Custom Grid
advanced.customGrid.description: Custom m0 layout for the grid (overrides rows/cols). One tile is bound per cell, in order — give some cells emphasis by sizing them. Other knobs still apply.

debugGeometry.label: Debug geometry
debugGeometry.description: Dev-only geometry contract: assert every tile's computed rect survived to the pixels at this canvas; on violation render a GEOMETRY_CONTRACT error mosaic. Deterministic default false; production never sets it.
